title: UPSC Combined Medical Services CMS Answer Key 2026
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for Combined Medical Services Examination (CMS) 2026
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download UPSC Combined Medical Services CMS Answer Key 2026
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: UPSC CMS Answer Key 2026 released. Check question papers and keys at upsc.gov.in.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Combined Medical Services (CMS) Answer Key 2026.

Candidates can download question papers and official keys from the UPSC website after the examination as per the commission’s schedule.
